title: Finding — the record_finding payload
description: Mirrors the connector's record_finding contract; the connector is authoritative and this file is the readable copy. One row per distinct defect, not per sighting: the same defect reported by three QA agents is ONE finding with three sightings. Dedup identity, unless dedup_key overrides it, is component | defect_class | (file_path or surface or gate_id) | title. Never pre-suppress a duplicate — record it and let the store decide, because the sighting count is the class signal. Recording a defect already marked RESOLVED returns a warning telling you to use report_recurrence instead; do that, or the link between the fix and its failure is severed.

title.description: One line: what is wrong. Part of the dedup identity, so write it as the defect rather than as the incident.

observed.description: What was actually seen, in the source's own words. Not a paraphrase — the detail dropped in paraphrase is usually what makes two sightings recognisable as one defect.

measurement.description: HOW it was measured: the command, the query, the HTTP status, or the count WITH its denominator. Refused below 30 characters, and 'it broke' is refused on purpose. A finding whose measurement is a feeling cannot be re-run, so nobody can ever say whether the fix held — which is the one question this store exists to answer.
examples: pytest apps/mcp/tests/test_field_census.py -q -> 1 failed: 10 item-level keys with no column, of 34 writers swept

component.description: api | mcp | web | worker | migrations | infra | skill:<name> | agent:<name>. A defect the synthesis skill produced is filed against that skill, which is what makes 'which skill produces the most defects' answerable.

defect_class.description: A class id from list_defect_classes. A FOREIGN KEY, not a label — a memory rots when one defect is filed under three synonyms. Read the vocabulary before filing.

new_class.description: Required ONLY when defect_class names a class that does not exist yet. A class may be invented, never invented silently. If you cannot write the probe, you do not yet understand the defect well enough to name it — file under the closest existing class and say why it fits badly.

tell.description: How it presents — what a reader notices before knowing the cause.

probe.description: The command or query that detects it. The most useful field in the taxonomy: a ready-made check to run against a suspicion before there is a finding.

raised_by.description: The agent, gate or person BY NAME.

expected.description: What it should have been. With measured_value this is the arithmetic a verdict would state.

file_path.description: Part of the dedup identity when present.

surface.description: Surface Spec id. Part of the dedup identity when file_path is absent.

gate_id.description: Part of the dedup identity when file_path and surface are absent.

annotation_id.description: Set by ingest_reviewer_feedback for a verdict-derived finding.

fix_hint.description: What to do about it. A hypothesis, allowed to be wrong — three sightings later it is what makes the cluster's rung obvious.

note.description: Free text for THIS sighting, not for the finding.

session_ref.description: The chat, Cowork session or CI job that saw it. What makes a sighting attributable across sessions.

source_ref.description: An idempotency token for this sighting.

dedup_key.description: Override the dedup identity. Use sparingly: a wrong override either merges two defects or splits one, and both corrupt the counts every rung decision depends on.
